subject: Vendor security questionnaire: SIG-Lite vs custom form — clarifying scope & evidence routing
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Mills <laura.mills@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — security scope and preferred questionnaire

Thanks again for the call earlier, Laura — good to meet the Vertex Health team. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can pick the right form to start (SIG-Lite, CAIQ, or a short customized set).

Summary of what I heard:
- You need HIPAA compliance for PHI workloads and prefer US-only data residency.
- SOC 2 Type II is in progress (estimated completion Q4 2026 per your note on the call).
- Primary integration will be server-to-server API calls (no file uploads by patients).

Clarifying asks to determine questionnaire path:
1) Would you be OK starting with a SIG-Lite prefilling (faster) and expanding to a custom follow-up for any high-risk items, or do you require CAIQ/full questionnaire upfront?
2) Can you confirm the PHI touchpoints (API only vs API + scheduled exports)? If exports exist, we need formats and locations.
3) Who should receive our completed prefills/evidence (security@vertexhealth or a named contact)?
4) Are there specific encryption/key management requirements beyond AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit?

Attachments: I’ve attached our SIG template (redwood_sig_template_v1.xlsx) and a one-page dataflow sketch (redwood_dataflow_sketch.pdf) that describes how we treat request-level metadata and logs.

Proposed next steps:
- If SIG-Lite is acceptable, we can prefill and return within ~5 business days after you confirm the recipient and share any sample dataflow.
- If you prefer a custom questionnaire, we’ll need the document and can estimate a turnaround after triage.

Happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Diego: (415) 555-0182
redwood.ai

From: Laura Mills <laura.mills@vertexhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — security scope and preferred questionnaire

Diego — thanks for the summary and the materials. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we are currently undergoing Type II and expect to have the report by Q4 2026. We can share interim evidence (control matrix export) now if that helps.
- HIPAA: yes, HIPAA compliance is required. We will need a BAA executed before any production PHI flows.
- Residency: US-only (data must be stored in US regions).

SIG-Lite: acceptable as a starting point as long as the prefilling includes KMS/key ownership details and deletion/retention controls.

Specific questions for Redwood (please answer or point us to docs):
1) Key management: who is the KMS holder — do you use customer-managed keys or Redwood-managed CMKs?
2) Egress logging: when data leaves our tenancy (exports or integrations), what logging/auditing is available and how long is that retained?
3) Offboarding: confirm your standard process for tenant data deletion and certificate of deletion (timeline and evidence).

I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire (vertex_vs_security_2026.docx) — it's the form our procurement/security team prefers if you need to respond directly.

If SIG-Lite works, please prefill and we will have our team review that first. We’ll also loop legal for the BAA once we have a scope.

Thanks,
Laura Mills
Director, IT Security — Vertex Health

Thanks for the forward, Diego. Quick guidance: 

- KMS: we support both Redwood-managed CMKs and customer-managed keys via KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). For PHI workload recommendation: offer them customer-managed CMKs (we can provide configuration docs and the operational runbook).

- Egress logging: we capture all export events in our audit log (immutable events sent to the tenant's log sink). Retention by default is 90 days; we can extend retention for enterprise deals — note this in the prefills and offer a longer retention addendum.

- Offboarding: standard process is deletion within 30 days of termination and a signed certificate of deletion. We can accelerate on request but require an L2 confirmation from infra. Add the 30-day SLA and certificate wording to the prefills.

Action plan:
1) Diego — prefill SIG-Lite and explicitly call out KMS options, audit/log retention default and enterprise extension, and the 30-day deletion SLA with a certificate of deletion. Attach our SOC2 control matrix export as interim evidence.
2) Soojin — confirm region pinning feasibility and provide short note about how Dedicated vs Private affects residency.
3) I will draft suggested language for BAA + KMS responsibilities and send to legal to review (cc Diego when ready).

We should be able to return a SIG-Lite prefilling + evidence bundle in ~5 business days after we get the sample dataflow or confirmation of export patterns from Vertex.

-Karthik
Principal, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
